annotations.title: Completed sales for a place, with summary

description:
Completed sales (HM Land Registry) in a place, newest first, each with
    distance_m from the place and age_months, plus a summary (count, median
    price, median £/m2 where floor area is known) over the newest 100 matches.
    Use it to answer "what has sold near here". `since` is an ISO date;
    `radius_m` (default 1000, at most 2000) applies to uprn and postcode places.

    Do NOT use it to say what a property is worth: sales are evidence, not a
    valuation, so quote them with their dates. For a value use the valuation
    tools. The summary is over the newest 100 matches, not all-time (basis.n
    and basis.decision say how many). England and Wales only; many sales lack
    floor area and bedrooms, so £/m2 covers a subset. Use this, not the
    one-month registered-sales market facet, for sold prices.
    Free.

    Every row carries `identity` (unit | building | street | unresolved): anything but `unit` may describe a block,
    so say so and ask which flat. `place` is exactly one of {uprn}, {postcode}, {area: {type, code}} or {geometry}
    (point + radius_m up to 2000, bbox up to 5 km, polygon up to 200 vertices); free text is refused, call resolve_place first.
    UK only. Limits: 25 rows per page by default, at most 100 (`limit`); more via `next_cursor`; a page is cut to 8 KB. Postcode districts and Welsh/Scottish authorities return covered=false with the reason.
    A call with covered=false or an upstream failure is not charged.

PlaceArg.description: Exactly one of uprn, postcode, area, geometry. Free text is refused: call resolve_place first.
